- Gray bar
- Blue indicator (moved right)
- Light blue square at right (position 4)

Now I need to figure out what happens when the indicator reaches certain positions. Maybe:
- Position 0: first pattern (cross)
- Position 1: second pattern
- Position 2: third pattern
- etc.
Or maybe the indicator position determines which pattern to match on the right panel.
Let me try pressing RIGHT again to see if the indicator moves further and if the left panel changes.
